title: FA/10/2002 of M/S SIKAND CONSTRUCTION COMP. Vs U.P.STATE ELECTRICITY BOARD and ANR.

paras.text:
MCC No. 590 of 2013
In
FA No. 10 of 2002
Hon'ble Prafulla C. Pant, J.
Shri I.P.Kohli, Advocate, present for the
appellant.
Shri Amar Shukla, Advocate, holding
brief of Shri Gopal Narain, Advocate, present
for the claimants/respondents.
Shri Naresh Pant, Advocate, present for
the respondent No.3.
This is Money Withdrawal Application
No. 590 of 2013 moved by the appellant for
release of the amount deposited before this
court.
Heard.
This appeal has been decided on merits
by this court vide its order dated 31.07.2013,
whereby the appeal (First Appeal No. 10 of
2002) has been allowed.
In the above circumstances, the Money
Withdrawal Application is allowed and the
appellant is permitted to withdraw the amount
Rs. 1,54,197.30 paisa deposited by him vide
challan dated 13.03.2002.
The record of the appeal be sent to the
record room.
